nom: Clarins V-Facial Instant Depuffing Face Mask

avis.texte: best firming mask I've found! I use this at least 2x a week if not more!

A very effective treatment for improving the look of your face. You can feel the mask as it works its magic. This is the second jar that I have purchased because it has become a regular part of my maintenance routine.

avis.titre: My face looks so rested after this
avis.texte: Love this mask! I use it twice a week and the difference is noticeable — pores look smaller, skin looks fresh and well-rested. It's become my little self-care ritual. Definitely repurchasing!
Wow! This mask exceeded my expectations. First time I used it people complimented my face glowing asking if I got Botox lol. Really amazing product if you have a big date or event to attend.
I recently bought this product and was very impressed the first time I used it. It's lovely, thick and creamy, and left my skin looking and feeling truly revived!

I received a sample of this and on the first use, my compromised, drip/flaking, and very mild rosacea skin with hormonal acne began to clear up after a few days of use. When I rinsed this mask, my face never felt so silky and comforted as if I wrapped my skin in a silk sheet. I do have minor puffiness only under my left eye for some reason (due to allergies) in the morning so I can't vouch for the puff reduction the company claims. I tried the masks at night since I give myself 40 mins to get ready to leave for work hence limited on self care lol. I'll be purchasing full size for my experience as it felt so good plus relieved my other skin issues Will see how it goes with the puffy claims.
It's ok. Have used it multiple times and haven't seen any change. All it does is make your face feel soft. Not worth the price.

I have used this twice so far and honestly I don't see a difference at all. I am halfway into my year 50 so I am looking to address the, thankfully, beginning stages of fine lines, wrinkles and collagen lost. I feel like aside from my eye area puffiness, my smile lines seem droopy unless I'm smiling Lol so I'm looking for a lift in that area. I feel like this mask is very very thick so after leaving it on for the recommended time its kinds hard to remove. I like using the disposable towels for both drying my face after I wash and by wetting it to remove masks or cleanser from my face and with this mask I need to go over my face fully twice and then I have to spot check to get and additional leftover mask. My face feels ok afterwards. Not dry not moisturized but just ok. I always immediately follow up with my hyaluronic acid and vitamin C serums so I haven't ever let my face sit untouched to see if my skin becomes dry or not. I use my red light therapy mask daily but usually at night so I haven't had the chance to see if it has any benefits on the masks effectiveness. Maybe I'll try on the weekend
Haven't seen any difference in my skin. Not sure what it's supposed to do. Seems like a waste of money.
LOVE THIS MASK!!!! I leave it on for about 90 mins but you can leave it on for however long you need. Snatches you right up!
This is a fast and easy facial mask that leaves me feeling refreshed and clean. I highly recommend this product.
I was really excited to receive this product for an event I had. Not only did it arrive late but it doesn't work. At. All. And I've tried it twice. Super disappointed
Love the texture, and the depuffing qualities. I've never encountered a mask like this one!

I was super hesitant about this line but ALL of the V shape projects, especially when used together are GOLD! The mask is great before I go to an event or want to really make sure I am looking my absolute best before a spray!

I received this as a sample with the serum purchase. I found it to be ok. I prefer a mask I can use all over my face. I'm not sure why the model in the video has to state that it will make you look "snatched" 3 times. Is this necessary? Not a selling factor.

I read the reviews after looking into this masque, and they encouraged me to purchase. I'm so glad I did. I love it, and have already used it 3 times. My face feels so clean after using. I highly recommend
Wow! This is such a great innovative product. My face looks and feels so good after I use it. It depuffs and plumps at the same time.
I love Clarins products. This is a great one for those unfortunate off days.

I really was hoping this lived up to the hype but unfortunately for me it did not. I did not see the slightest improvement in puffiness which was the main improvement I was hoping to see for those days I'm just a bit more puffy. It was non irritating and didn't break me out or cause me to feel dry/tight so that was a plus, just my main goal was not achieved with this product.
This product is magic in a bottle! It helps to seriously depuff my skin which is most important to me but it also brightens my skin giving it a lovely glow! Buy it!
Wonderful mask. It does well on firming the "V" area. I like it applying on my face and washing away easily.
Just got the product. Not 100% sure that i will keep it. It dries my face although its consistency is fine.

avis.titre: An excellent consistency and the results
avis.texte: Love this new product and the fact that I do not have to use too much of it. I like the results post usage. It clears up the complexion. Much better product than the Cryo Mask that I could not take it. Thanks Clarins.

avis.titre: Reduces fat under the chin and sagging jowls.
avis.texte: I use this every couple days, even overnight. Helps to reduce the fat under the chin and the jowls. I have been using this for years.
Love this product ❤️ there are so many products I love of Clarins. You really can't go wrong with anything.

avis.titre: The box says it is for Asian women
avis.texte: Nothing in the description says it is for Asian women but the box says created for Asian women very disappointed they do not say this up front

When i first started using this mask, I was not sure if it would work. However I have noticed tighter jaw line and a few surprises. Surprise 1: better skin tone - I have some pigmentation on my cheeks and I have noticed that they are lighter. Surprise 2: smaller pores on my cheeks. This is a great product 0 highly recommend
So amazing. Great at tightening and depuffing! Will buy again!

avis.titre: Love it! Can I also use it on top half of face
avis.texte: Love the product! Depuffs my jawline and neck. Curious if I can also use it on the top half portion of my face around my eyes and forehead . Thanks

avis.titre: I will not use this product again, thank you.
avis.texte: This product is not working for me, maybe it's not for my skin type.
My skin felt so soft & moisturized after the first application. It lasted several days.
Amazing product-works as described. Definitely will repurchase
I use this product in my room as an aesthetician. The results are night day everyone loves it.
Made my skin so soft and radiant and I loved the scent and texture of the mask
This wrap is a go to whenever I need to depuff my face and help restore a a bit of radiance to my face. Highly recommended.
Will NEVER be without this! Works wonderfully even under eyes and all over face a neck
This is the BEST MASK EVER. It truly does what it says. Makes my jaw snatched!

Omg I couldn't believe that after 1 use for face mask, I can see a little bit more of my jawline! Amazing result! I have been using the V Shaping Facial Lift Serum for years and it was a very slow process but this mask is on a different level! I can't wait to finish my jar and buy another!
Excellent product. I look forward to using this each morning.

Gave me the V face contour that it said it would! I didn't have that before! You can feel the mask tightening your face but it's really gentle and non irritating. 11/10 would buy again. Of note: I do have Asian skin and it said it works best on Asian skin on the packaging.

Seriously worth the purchase. Makes me feel so much "prettier" before an event or just a night out! You can actually SEE the de-puffing results (but I do suggest wearing for closer to an hour). Amazing product that does what it says!

I really wanted to love this product based on the reviews. However, it made my chin breakout really bad and I also didn't notice a difference with the rest of my face. Will not be using and returning this product.
I have been a Clarins customer my entire adult life and it's rare I don't like something, but this didn't work at all and also made me break out

avis.titre: Oh my God just buy it
avis.texte: I had little optimism about this but tried it anyway. I cannot believe my skin! I used it this morning and my face is glowing and looks so much less puffy. Buying another jar now in cases they discontinue or change it. One of the few good products I've tried all year.
Thank you for making a product that makes me look wide eyed and ready to go after a quick 10 minutes!
Follow @kathleenjenningsbeauty for how to best depuff, but this stuff is a holy grail, take to a desert island item!

avis.titre: Most Amazing Product I Have Used in Years!
avis.texte: While I expected some results (Clarins products always impress me), I have been blown away with how unbelievably wonderful and effective this mask is! I don't think there will ever be a time when I am without it! Just look at the before and after pictures! It is worth every dollar! I would love to try the rest of the products related to this mask!
Not only does is help de-puff but smells great! I am very skeptical about products, but would highly recommend this!
I love this mask. It's the first product that actually brings all the impurities to the surface.
Could not get by without the clarins mask!!! A depuff must per Kathleen Jennings and it's proven very effective. Going on year 3 of being a loyal clarins fan!

avis.titre: What a dream product! I can't live or travel w/o
avis.texte: Reduces so much excess fluids from my face, I need this every day
This is the best face mask I've ever tried. It's thick and creamy and leaves my face hydrated and depuffed. Worth every penny.

Honestly this mask did more than what I thought was possible. My face looks normal and snatched again after weeks of puffiness. Only left it on for 15 minutes and my skin looks bright and tight. Amazing product.

avis.titre: Push pause on the puffy hormone button
avis.texte: So glad I found this! Peri-menopausal symptoms can cause facial puffiness. This product is a life saver, I use it about 1-2 times per week. My cheekbones have reappeared!

I was directed to this product from one of my favorite influencers and it does not disappoint - I use it in conjunction with an inexpensive peel product and love how glowy and plump my skin feels after that routine. I think this is an excellent compliment to a good regimen and helps with those puffy, dehydrated days when you need a pick me up.

I recently bought this product and am reaping the benefits with de puffing my face! I would like to volunteer and add suggestions with packaging and instructions. I think big markets like yours need voices from the lay people in regards to how to better market your product.

I am picky when it comes to skincare, as I should be. I've developed my preferences and have acquired too many masks in the process. I'm going through them one by one getting rid of the ones that don't make the cut. This one though, may be perfect and I'm glad because it was pricy and stayed in my save for later wish list for quite a while. The consistency feels elegant, the perfect amount of clay to fluffy feeling, the smell is not bothersome, it doesn't irritate my skin. it's a winner.

Coming from a 50 years old, and definitely really picky when it's comes to a new product to try; and being my first time user I needed to be assured, that I did not waste my hard earned money on this amazingly to say Intensif Lifting Masque. My face usually dry from eczema, and the drying rash would be embarassing, but masque instantly help moisturized these area and left me with a glowing beautiful face. And also, it helped getting rid of the rings around my eyes. I call product "The Wonder Cream" is a must try judge it for yourself (the longer you leave it on the better your skin texture will become). Thank you for you so much!!! An God ßlessed!!!
Amazing! Works like a charm for de-puffing and revitalization!
I was pleasantly surprised at how well this worked to firm up my 60-year-old sagging skin around lower cheeks and neck. Will definitely buy again.
I have only used once but didn't feel like it changed my jaw line that much. I will continue to use for special events and my wedding to see if I just missed something.

I'll start this by saying I am not Asian and, perhaps because of that, not the target demographic for this mask. Nevertheless, I love it so far. I have adult acne caused by hormones after getting an IUD—this, in conjunction with the brightening serum, has done wonders for my uneven complexion and cystic acne in just two applications. My round face somehow feels oval, my skin is taught, and I'm not puffy from hormones (or from the hot sauce I ate last night). Overall, would (and will) buy again. 10/10.

avis.titre: Feels like a little piece of heaven !
avis.texte: I watched the product live stream with your beauty experts which was how I decided to try the product. Without them I would not have applied correctly.. Really works on a tired face , gives a great lift and smells and feels delightful... Have bought for my daughter and she was also impressed with the results..
This product really helps with facial puffiness! I can see a very noticeable difference after 10 minutes! Well worth the $$ in my opinion!
I did not believe it would work but I tried the sample size and saw immediate result's

Feels so great on my skin when applying. The smell itself reminds me of Paris. The packaging feels so rich. I apply this mask on a regular weekly basis, my face looks so slim . People always compliment me on me weight loss little did they know it was this amazing mask!!
I was hesitant about this because of the price but it was worth it! My fine lines were diminished after just one use. My skin feels nourished and soft and less puffy. I love this product!

I bought this mask per the Sister studio and I am not complaining. It leaves my skin feeling soft and plump. Really helps to fight the hormonal changes of my skin. Love the way my skin looks after using this mask.

The results are subtle yet noticeable. For me this mask helps to depuff and give a refreshed look to my face. It's not a face lift but it is similar to getting rest and having been to spa spa for a week. I would recommend leaving it on for at least 30 minutes.

I have been religiously following this serum. I cannot live without this product. My face is chubby and round, and I use this to make it look little thinner and oval shaped and this does it !!!! I hope this never discontinues! I follow the instructions of the serum, of how to apply it and it works magic!
I love this product. It leaves my face feeling vibrant and beautiful

I have been using for about two weeks. Not sure if I see a difference. I'm 40 and I guess my face isn't swollen but I bought in hopes that it will finish my jowls that I can see wanting to develop. I don't like how white and opaque it is but it does leave your skin feeling soft and nice. Probably won't ever buy again
You see results! Helps so much with de-puffing! A little goes a long way, so it lasts me a while too.
This product is amazing! After a few times of using this product I can notice my face is a little slimmer. Works perfect after a night of drinking.

Love that you can leave it for 10 minutes only which is good as I am always on the run with a hectic and busy schedule. It helps in firming and toning my skin. I am very pleased with my skin looking clearer and I have recommended it to my friends too.

The minute this jar is empty, I buy a new one. It does a better job than any other mask I have tried at depuffing my overall face. I also put it on my eyelids and neck and it helps in those areas too. This is the best mask out there for depuffing!

avis.titre: Silky, fresh, and does the job!
avis.texte: I have been using this product for over a year and I love it! My skin feels like a spa treatment with this wrap as part of my regular routine.

I absolutely love this product!! It does exactly what it says it does.. it depuffs and makes your face look more slimming and more awake! I use it after a night of consuming adult beverages or before a fun event! It truly makes a difference in how my face looks and I am so glad I found this product!!
I have been using the V wrap intensive facial for a few months now. I get so many compliments on how youthful my skin looks. I will soon be 64.
I was influenced into buying this and so glad I did! It really helps depuff my face! I use it two times a week and will definitely repurchase.
I like how cool awesome feeling when i put it on my face.and the swollen face will gone every morning after I put it on

This mask is great to use before some special event when you want to look 100% flawless. It makes the extra fluids (=extra chin) disappear. I'm using it before photoshoots so the model's face looks perfect. Make sure you follow the directions because the way it's applied is important to achieve maximum results. The other two V-facial (eyes and face serum) are also in my arsenal, nothing can't beat the best. Tried almost all products on the market and Clarins is #1. Highly recommend.
. I started using this 5 years ago and after every use, I feel my skin becomes firmer.
I totally love this product. It really takes care of the puffiness on my face. I can't live without it!

avis.titre: Great for getting rid of bloating
avis.texte: This mask is the only product I've found that actually flushes bloating away after too much sodium or alcohol. I'm sensetive to both, and have always been self conscious about it. I'm now a user of this facial wrap for life!
This works exactly like you'd think! Depuff and firm. A staple in my beauty routine.

I have been wanting to try this forever . I've used it twice since u received it this week. It's great. My face feels amazing, smooth and has made my small lines less prominent by my mouth. I love it !!

The intensive wrap has a luxurious and smooth texture. My skin responds well to the dense nutrients. It applies easily and stays moist, unlike other masks, so I am able to keep this on longer. I feel and see results after a few uses and try to use twice a week.
I bought this after the sister studio recommended it. And, I am so glad I did. The puffiness is gone and my skin looks so much more resfreshed. I definitely will purchase again.

avis.titre: Really, really helps with under eye puffiness!!
avis.texte: I bought this after hearing Kathleen Jennings on IG. I'm sold. It really is that good!!
I'm pretty sure this does help with depuffing. Not a huge difference but it does seem to do something.
Thanks to Kathleen Jennings it hooked on this product! It's my holy grail and I've told all my friends!

I got a sample of this with one of my orders. I tried the sample and loved it so I bought it. I've been using it for months and I love the way it feels on my skin and how great my skin looks after. It's a nice relaxing few moments of pampering that also makes my skin feel and look great.

I know all my Instagram influencers are obsessed with this product and it IS worth all the hype. I use it every Saturday and leave it on for an hour and notice a HUGE difference. It is one of the better face masks I have ever used!
This mask is perfect before a big event. My face feels tighter and brighter

This is the BEST mask I own. I could use it every day. The lifting and slimming is real! I look ten pounds lighter when I put this over my jawline. Bags under my eyes? Layer with some of this. Puffy from drinking the night before? Mask up. I keep two of these as a backup at all times. It's no wonder it always sells out. I have convinced so many friends and family members to buy this and they have not been disappointed!

I bought this product because I have been obsessed with Clarins products. This amazing container is helping me with a part of my face that's a bit discolored. I know my results are going to be amazing.
I use this probably 2/3 times a week, after a long week or night. It actually works..your skin feels firmer and smooth. I have sensitive skin and it still works and feels great.

avis.titre: V-FACIAL INTENSIVE WRAP BRINGS OUT YOUR BEST!
avis.texte: Tones, slims, and hydrates the face and neck. What more could you ask for? I always use this mask if I have a special event coming up.
Amazing during last months of pregnancy. Face feels slimmer instantly.
This product is still new to me. It feels wonderful on the face but not sure about results.
Im trying this cream for the fist time and im having a awesome result.
follow the directions on how to use and it is a jar of gold for your skin! I saw and felt results my first use!
Excelente producto Excellent product. I love how my skin looks.
I bought this a few weeks ago and I love it! I love the way it makes my skin feel

I wanted to love this, but saw absolutely no change in my face. Nothing. I was disappointed and frankly, surprised, given its rave reviews. It must work for lots of people, but not for me. I have returned it.

avis.titre: My face looks so good, I never want to be without
avis.texte: Just purchased my second jar. I keep it on for an hour or however long I feel like, when I walk my dog in the morning etc. My face looks like I went on a three-day cleanse when I wash it off. It's The Best, I have recommended it to my friend group, colleagues, aunts, cousins...

I really love this mask and the sleep mask and I use them both regularly. I find the V-Facial really brings the moisture into my skin. There is no residual cream to make it oily. I love using this once a week along with the Restore sleep mask.
very impressed with this mask, skin feels & looks great after using

This mask is....nothing short of amazing! I'm pushing 60, thought nothing would help my skin. Was I ever so wrong! If you're on the fence about buying it, jump off that fence and buy it! You will LOVE this mask!!!

This is one of my Holy Grail Products. I am very sensitive to salt and alcohol. I get extremely puffy- this is one of the only products that makes me less puffy and brightens at the same time. I usually start to panic if I run low. There is a reason it is out of stock so often!

I used this product a few times. To my surprise, this products gave an immediate feeling of relaxation, and appearance of reducing puffiness. My face did look like the "after" picture that was on Clarin's web site.
